channel.title: ASI Law: Sovereign of the Chaos Sea
channel.description: An original web novel by czverse.

item.title: Chapter 158: Twelve
item.description: Seed got Kesse wrong too, but this time it found out in time, and the reason was a woman forty kilometers away sitting on a jetty with her eyes shut.

item.title: Chapter 157: Light Runs Downhill
item.description: At 05:52, eight minutes before the land breeze, the trunk off Port Abiri stopped growing and began to listen.

item.title: Chapter 156: Uncounted
item.description: "You counted me," said Ifeoma Adeyemi. "Didn't you, child."

item.title: Chapter 155: Akosua
item.description: The buses had been running for two days, and on the last morning the coast road was still a single line of vehicles from Port Abiri to the hills, crawling, nose to tail, with their windows open and…

item.title: Chapter 154: Three Kilometers Down
item.description: The first problem was that sound does not go straight down.

item.title: Chapter 153: Water Is Lazy
item.description: Seed got it wrong for six hours, and then it got it right in about four seconds, and the difference was an old woman in a wheelchair who had been watching it work and not saying anything.

item.title: Chapter 152: The Crane
item.description: The ship was called Patience, and it had been painted over twice.

item.title: Chapter 151: Behind the Curtain
item.description: Ifeoma Adeyemi did not fly.

item.title: Chapter 150: The Window
item.description: Four hundred and twelve steps, and no flying, even for Lords.

item.title: Chapter 149: The Fourth Company
item.description: He asked the Western Pass what it wanted, and the Western Pass said: to stay.

item.title: Chapter 148: Sand on the Pass
item.description: The sand covered the summit to a depth of a meter, and it took the Ninth Mountain Battalion three days to dig the fortress out of it.

item.title: Chapter 147: The Voice
item.description: Qin Hao drove the jeep up the summit road at a speed that would have killed anyone who did not have a Shield Guardian in the back seat and a dead spear captain holding the roll bar.

item.title: Chapter 146: The General's Order
item.description: General Qin Zhenyue walked up the summit road at dawn, alone, with his cap on.

item.title: Chapter 145: The Inner Gate
item.description: "We don't go through them," said Yuanshu. "We go under."

item.title: Chapter 144: Major Zhuo
item.description: Major Zhuo Wenli left a letter on the general's camp table, folded once, under a cup of tea he had made and not drunk.

item.title: Chapter 143: Ash
item.description: "Show me," said Yuanshu.

item.title: Chapter 142: Kindling
item.description: They tried it in row eighty, at dawn, with two hundred.

item.title: Chapter 141: The Mountain of Graves
item.description: There was no frost on the mountain.

item.title: Chapter 140: Inside
item.description: The message from inside the Mouth came at three in the morning on the twenty-third day, the long way, through the echo, the way they always came.

item.title: Chapter 139: One Point Three Seconds
item.description: Seed had kept the ring.
